# opencode-shiftwork

[Shiftwork](https://github.com/Ivlad003/shiftwork) for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) **V2**.

**In development. This version registers nothing yet.**

Planned:
- a fresh session per ticket (`ctx.session.create`)
- skill tiers through `skill` permission rules
- model handoff on budgets
- provider fallback on `provider.rate-limit` and `provider.quota`
